events.text: First Half begins.
Own Goal by Victor Lindelöf, Aston Villa. Brighton and Hove Albion 1, Aston Villa 0.
Pascal Groß (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
João Gomes (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card.
Yasin Ayari (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 2, Aston Villa 0. Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton and Hove Albion) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Georginio Rutter.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 3, Aston Villa 0. Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton and Hove Albion) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Diego Gómez with a headed pass.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 4, Aston Villa 0. Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
John McGinn (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
João Gomes (Aston Villa) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
First Half ends, Brighton and Hove Albion 4, Aston Villa 0.
Second Half begins Brighton and Hove Albion 4, Aston Villa 0.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
